:::{#sol-miller-deriv-tangent-line-approx-compare}

The exact [value](functions.qmd#def-value) is:

$$f(\pi/4 + 0.01) = 4\paren{\frac{\pi}{4} + 0.01} + \sqrt{2}\cosf{\frac{\pi}{4} + 0.01} \approx 4.171543$$

The approximation error is $|4.171593 - 4.171543| \approx 0.00005$, on the order of $(0.01)^2 = 10^{-4}$.

:::
